messages:
jordan: FYI found CVE-2026-1234 affecting transitive dep 'fastidx' used by our tokenizer layer. PoC shows a crash during batch prep on longer sequences. filing initial triage.
samira: link to PoC? severity? :eyes:
jordan: https://github.com/advisories/CVE-2026-1234
jordan: PoC attached in the issue. Crash only on builds using libfastidx v2.4.0. We vendor a copy into runtime image for Dedicated + Private.
ashwin: is this remotely exploitable or local crash on malformed input? any RCE path? we need that to set priority.
jordan: seems DoS/crash only from untrusted input parsing. no RCE seen so far. exploitability limited, but affects latency SLOs and could trigger failovers for heavy traffic tenants.
ashwin: ok so availability impact. For Dedicated we can roll a hotpatch image. For Private/on-prem it's trickier — many customers pin base OS and use air-gapped registries.
nancy: customer engagement note: two large customers (acme / zephyr) use private images pinned to sha256 and disable auto-updates. they'll need a customer-specific image and a manual install path.
samira: what's the suggested branching strategy? do we create a hotfix branch off the release tag and cherry-pick into the long-lived onprem branches?
jordan: my proposal:

1) create branch `hotfix/cve-2026-1234` off `release-1.2.x`
2) cherry-pick minimal patch to bump fastidx to 2.4.1 with the upstream fix
3) build two images: `rwd-infer:1.2.7-hotfix-cve2026` (hosted/dedicated) and `rwd-infer-private:1.2.7-hotfix-cve2026` (onprem customer images)
4) produce signing metadata and a manual install guide for customers

ashwin: +1 but note: Private images use musl-based scratch layer for some customers; the tiny patch in fastidx requires rebuilding with glibc toolchain for compatibility. We'll need CI matrix: linux/glibc and linux/musl.

samira: can we automate builds for both toolchains? build matrix in CI will add ~25m per artifact.

ashwin: yes, but add a selective matrix only for hotfix branch.

nancy: customer comms: we should offer to push signed tarballs to their registries via support-run. also confirm KMS key rotation won't break signature verification for them.
jordan: important point — our image signing uses KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222:key/abcd. For Private, we sometimes export a delegated signing cert for offline signing. if we push hotfix images to customers, need to document verification commands.
samira: on RBAC: the hotfix requires the runtime to write an extra audit log entry when tokenizer drops malformed batch. That implies adding a new permission in the audit service: `audit.write.tokenizer`. Is it safe to add for all tenants?
ashwin: default deny, but we can add it to existing runtime service account role. For Private, add a migration note — if customers lock down service account roles, they'll need to add the permission.

nancy: recommend adding migration snippet in release notes:

```
# allow tokenizer audit writes
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: rwd-runtime-logger
rules:
- apiGroups: ["audit.redwood.com"]
  resources: ["tokenizerlogs"]
  verbs: ["create"]
EOF
```

samira: backport priority: I'd set P2 (high availability) — not P1 since no RCE, but customers with tight SLOs need quick patch.
jordan: agreed. timeline: prepare hotfix branch today, CI builds + smoke tests tomorrow, staged rollout to Dedicated in 48h, and private images available via signed tarball in 72h.

ashwin: we also need to validate metrics: ensure KV cache warm paths unaffected. Add regression test in nightly that runs long-seq parse workload.

deploy-bot: build started: hotfix/cve-2026-1234 #1 (matrix glibc,musl) — logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/1234 :gear:

samira: docs: include manual install steps and verification:

```
# pull hotfix private image (air-gapped)
oci-tool fetch --from /mnt/usb/rwd-infer-private-1.2.7-hotfix-cve2026.tar.gz
oci-tool verify --key /etc/rwd/signing_cert.pem
sudo systemctl restart rwd-infer
```

nancy: I'm going to draft an email template for affected customers and flag accounts running release-1.2.x with pinned images.
samira: assign owners: jordan triage + patch, ashwin CI/builds + matrix, nancy customer install + comms. I'll own rollout and release notes.
jordan: created ticket INF-4872 with the plan and PoC link.

ashwin: small follow-up — some onprem installers mount /opt/rwd as read-only and use an init container to unpack. hotfix image must remain compatible with that flow.

nancy: noted. will call key customers for install windows.
samira: thanks everyone. will update thread when builds complete. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: build matrix completed: all green except musl-variant failing on link-time due to toolchain. marking musl build as blocker for private images.

ashwin: putting musl toolchain fix on my plate, ETA 24h. will push a patched builder image.

jordan: ok moving to P2 with explicit musl-blocker tag. thanks all.
